name: Nahima
source:
Kionna’s best friend and confident, she’s always there to take care of her. But when the King announces his desire to marry the princess, she finds herself powerless to help the one she loves the most. Slowly but surely, she can feel the girl drifting apart from her…

[from [url=http://traumendes-madchen.com/chronotopia/]Träumendes Mädchen's site[/url]]
